QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set and the compiler is GNU-compatible (`constant_time_impl.h:40–52`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined in the header from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus a compiler check, not from a config entry. It never says "derived" or "not in mbedtls_config.h" in so many words, but the mechanism is stated.
